# starrocks_global_variable (Resource)

Manages a StarRocks global system variable. Applies the value cluster-wide via `SET GLOBAL`. Destroying the resource resets the variable to its default value with `SET GLOBAL <name> = DEFAULT`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Query timeout — controls how long (seconds) a query can run cluster-wide.
# Destroying this resource resets query_timeout to its StarRocks default.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "starrocks_global_variable" "query_timeout" {
  name  = "query_timeout"
  value = "600"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Memory limit per query on each BE node (bytes).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "starrocks_global_variable" "exec_mem_limit" {
  name  = "exec_mem_limit"
  value = "4294967296" # 4 GiB
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Enable or disable the query profile (boolean variable).
# StarRocks stores booleans as "true" / "false" strings.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "starrocks_global_variable" "enable_profile" {
  name  = "enable_profile"
  value = "true"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Multiple variables managed together so they are all reset atomically
# when the module is destroyed.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "starrocks_global_variable" "pipeline_dop" {
  name  = "pipeline_dop"
  value = "0" # 0 = auto-detect from CPU cores
}

resource "starrocks_global_variable" "parallel_fragment_exec_instance_num" {
  name  = "parallel_fragment_exec_instance_num"
  value = "8"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The variable name (e.g. `query_timeout`, `exec_mem_limit`). Changing this attribute destroys the old resource and creates a new one.
- `value` (String) The desired global value. Always supplied as a string; StarRocks coerces it to the variable's underlying type (integer, boolean, etc.).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a global variable by its name.
# The current value is read from SHOW GLOBAL VARIABLES and stored in state.
terraform import starrocks_global_variable.query_timeout query_timeout
```
